goals.1: mein / meine — the right form of “my”
goals.3: Introducing your family by showing a photo
dialog.3.de.0.n: haben: du hast — the full forms come in the next lesson
dialog.3.de.2.n: Geschwister is plural only: brother + sister
dialog.4.de.3.n: der Bruder + haben → einen (ein becomes einen for masculine words)
dialog.4.de.6.n: die Schwester → eine (it does not change)
grammar.0.title: mein / meine — “my”
grammar.0.intro: If the article is der or das, use mein; if it is die or a plural, use meine. For du the same rule gives dein / deine.
grammar.0.note: Short rule: the die-group (feminine and plural) → add -e at the end.
grammar.1.title: Plural
grammar.1.intro: In the plural the article is always die. In many words a → ä and o → ö.
grammar.1.note: Plurals have to be learned separately — whenever you learn a word, learn its plural too.
grammar.2.text: „Wer ist das?“ = Who is this? Answer: „Das ist mein Vater.“ When you point at a picture or a person you can always say „Das ist …“ — whatever the gender.
quiz.5.prompt: What is the plural of Bruder?
quiz.6.options.0: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
quiz.6.why: Geschwister = siblings; Hast du … ? = Do you have … ?
quiz.7.prompt: Put the words in order: “This is my family.”
